title: Mutual Non-Disclosure and Confidentiality Agreement under the Indian Contract Act, 1872
whenToUse: Use when two commercial corporations, startups, or business entities evaluate a joint venture, investment, M&A, or commercial partnership requiring mutual exchange of proprietary confidential information.
variantComparisonNote: Comprehensive mutual confidentiality agreement under Indian Contract Act, 1872. Distinct from employment executive agreements and unilateral notices.
youWillNeed: Party corporate details, CIN, definition of proposed business purpose, term of disclosure.
legalBasis: Indian Contract Act, 1872 (Sections 10, 27 & 73); Specific Relief Act, 1963; Zee Telefilms Ltd. v. Sundial Communications (2003).
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Clear definition and demarcation of Confidential Information
Specific enumeration of Permitted Purpose and standard of care
Exclusions from confidentiality (prior public knowledge, independent discovery, court order)
Remedies acknowledging monetary damages inadequate and entitling injunctive relief

particulars.label: Party A Corporate Name
particulars.description: Full legal name of First Party

particulars.label: Party B Corporate Name
particulars.description: Full legal name of Second Party

aiBlocks.title: Definition & Protection of Confidential Information
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Define confidential information broadly covering technical, algorithmic, financial, customer, and strategic data disclosed for {{FACT:authorized_business_purpose}}.

aiBlocks.title: Non-Disclosure Covenants & Exclusions
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft strict degree of care obligations, need-to-know restrictions, and customary exclusions (public domain, independent creation, compelled legal disclosure).

aiBlocks.title: Term, Surrender of Records & Injunctive Remedies
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft 3-year survival term, mandatory return/destruction of data upon demand, and explicit stipulation entitling injunctive relief under Specific Relief Act.
